direction.premise: A pocket field exercise with two squads fighting over one marked sector.
direction.composition: An exposed seven-column playing board dominates the exercise sheet, with a narrow score line and simple turn controls.
direction.shapeLanguage: Square terrain tiles and solid diamond counters act as distinct geometric markers.
direction.surfaceAndMaterial: Matte sand paper and dark ink frame the grid, without gradients or glass effects.
direction.paletteLogic: Blue and rust separate squads, ochre marks the objective, green outlines legal moves.
direction.typography: Heavy condensed-looking system headline with compact plain operational labels.
direction.signature: Legal move outlines turn into amber attack outlines on the actual opposing counter.
direction.distinction: A direct move-or-fire exercise with a scoring objective rather than hidden programmed commands.

architecture.primaryVerb: Tap a neighboring square to move or tap an outlined enemy to shoot.
architecture.physicalFeedback: Buttons depress during contact and a changed counter or score confirms the action.
architecture.spatialRationale: The seven-square width fits a narrow screen, keeping each action on its actual target.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A single fixed tactical grid replaces the expansive geography and research ledger.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Each input resolves one squad action rather than modifying an autonomous historical simulation.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A small fixed board takes the place of the documentary map and archive layout.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Players contest the objective through alternating legal actions instead of exploring authored stories.

comparisons.spatialDifference: A fixed seven by seven board contains colored combat counters rather than a pattern workspace.
comparisons.interactionDifference: Targeted movement and attacks replace the observation of evolving mathematical patterns.

production.renderer: Semantic DOM buttons in a seven-column CSS grid render the authoritative tactical state.
production.focalAsset: An original crossed diagonal SVG with an ochre objective disc identifies the field exercise.

motion.character: Brief press displacement and tile color changes keep each turn readable.
motion.action: A tap on an outlined destination triggers the corresponding legal move or attack.
motion.anticipation: Only legal action destinations are outlined before the player selects a target.
motion.response: The counter or its health value changes immediately after an accepted turn.
motion.followThrough: The score line and active counter indicate the resulting state and next turn.
motion.interruption: Returning to the menu closes the connection and removes the current board.
motion.reducedMotion: CSS disables transitions without changing legal actions or board state.

evidence.expectedChange: The mode selector is replaced by a seven by seven board with two opposing counters and score.
